conditions: straight stitch No. 1 (centre), needle at lowest point
reference: upper end of needle to surface of hook race

label: Buttonhole foot frame position
valueText: At this time, the presser foot frame should be about 1mm frontward from the extreme end.
conditions: service program Sensor test, buttonhole foot
reference: buttonhole foot frame from extreme end

label: Bobbin winder stop (thread to bobbin edge)
valueText: the machine should stop when there is a min. of 1 mm between the edge of the bobbin and the thread
reference: edge of bobbin to wound thread

label: Thread take-up lever play at crank stud
valueText: The journalling of the guide arm (A) shall be in such a position as to allow a maximum play of 0.2 mm at the journalling of the thread take-up lever in the crank stud.
reference: thread take-up lever journal in crank stud

label: Needle rise for hook timing
valueText: As the needle is moving upward the tip of the hook should pass the centre of the needle when the needle is 2.5 mm above the lower turning position (the distance for forming the loop).
conditions: straight stitching
reference: needle rise from lower turning position; hook tip at centre of needle

label: Upper position of needle bar (right-hand position check)
valueText: When the tip of the hook reaches the centre line of the needle, the underneath of the tip should be in line with the top edge of the needle eye.
conditions: zig-zag, right-hand position, stitch length 6 mm
reference: underside of hook tip level with top edge of needle eye

label: Hook tip to needle eye gap (centre position)
valueText: The gap between the tip of the hook and the needle eye, with the needle at the centre position (1.5 mm) is the starting measurement
conditions: needle at centre position
reference: tip of hook to needle eye
notes: manual says this is hard to estimate; use the right-hand position check instead

label: Presser bar lift
valueText: The lift of the presser bar should be 7 mm.
reference: presser bar lift

label: Zig-zag sideways movement completed (needle height)
valueText: The sideways movement of the needle must be completed when the needle is about 6 mm above the level of the stitch plate. There is no possibility of adjustment.
reference: needle above stitch plate when sideways movement ends

label: Thread tension release arm to lever hole gap
valueText: Apply pressure to the upper part of the lever until the release arm is freed and there is a gap of approx. 0.5 mm between the release arm and the hole in the lever.
conditions: presser bar lifter lowered
reference: release arm to hole in lever

label: Feed dog lift (gauge)
valueText: The setting gauge 411 49 93-01 will give a feed dog lift of 1 mm.
reference: feed dog in contact with setting gauge

label: Needle to hook gap
valueText: The gap should be as small as possible, but max 0.15 mm.
reference: needle to hook point

label: Needle rise for hook timing
valueText: the tip of the hook should pass behind the centre of the needle, when the needle is 2.5 mm above its lower turning position
reference: needle rise from lower turning position; hook tip behind centre of needle

label: Needle height (needle top to hook ring)
valueText: The gap between the upper end of the needle and the surface (B) of the hook ring should be 29.15 +/- 0.2 mm.
conditions: needle at lower turning position
reference: upper end of needle to surface B of hook ring

label: Presser foot lift (highest position)
valueText: the presser foot is approx. 13 mm above the stitch plate.
conditions: presser foot at highest lifting position
reference: presser foot above stitch plate

label: Hook height (bobbin case to case holder)
valueText: The distance between the bobbin case and the case holder should be 0.5 + 0.1 / -0,05 mm.
reference: bobbin case to case holder at the two marked positions

label: Feed dog height
valueText: The top of the feed dog should be 0.9-1.1 mm above the stitch plate.
conditions: feed dog at highest position
reference: top of feed dog above stitch plate

label: Needle bar height
valueText: The distance between the tip of the left needle and the needle plate shoud be 11.8 - 12.2 mm when the needle bar is at the highest position.
conditions: No. 90 needle in left (L) position only; needle bar at highest position
reference: tip of left needle to needle plate surface

label: Presser foot height (raised)
valueText: The distance between the bottom of the presser foot and the needle plate shoud be 4.6 - 4.8 mm when the needle bar is at the highest position.
conditions: presser foot lever raised; feed dog below needle plate; needle bar at highest position
reference: bottom of presser foot to needle plate
notes: Foot must be parallel with needle plate.

label: Feed dog to needle plate slot, rear end
valueText: The clearance between the feed dog and needle plate shoud be ... 0.3 - 0.5 mm at the rear end.
conditions: S.L. dial at 5; feed dog at rear end of travel
reference: feed dog to needle plate slot (rear)
notes: Set to 0.4 mm by moving the feed bar.

label: Feed dog to needle plate slot, front end
valueText: The clearance between the feed dog and needle plate shoud be 0.7 mm at the front end
conditions: S.L. dial at 5; feed dog at front end of travel
reference: feed dog to needle plate slot (front)

label: Feed dog height (foot-to-plate gap)
valueText: When the presser foot is lowered and the feed dog is at the heighest position, the distance between the surface of the needle plate and bottom of the presser foot should be 1.2 - 1.5 mm.
conditions: S.L. dial 0.5, D.F. dial 1; presser foot lowered; feed dog at highest position
reference: needle plate surface to bottom of lowered presser foot
tools: Gauge No. 11951 (1.3 mm step, gauge should just lift off the plate)
notes: Sub feed dog set to same height as main feed dog.

label: Main to sub feed dog distance
valueText: Check the distance between the main and sub feed dogs which should be 2.7 - 3.2 mm.
conditions: feed dogs at highest position
reference: gap between main and sub feed dogs

label: Upper knife height at lowest position
valueText: The lower edge of the moving blade (upper knife) should be 0.5 - 1.25 mm lower than the upper edge of the fixed blade (lower knife).
conditions: needle at lowest position
reference: lower edge of moving blade below upper edge of fixed blade
notes: Knife timing: moving blade at highest point when needle is at highest position (align marks B and C).

label: Horizontal feed timing (needle marks)
valueText: The needle marks w and e are within 0.2 mm from the needle mark q.
conditions: S.L. dial 4, D.F. dial 1; right needle removed; paper under foot
reference: needle marks made just as needle leaves / enters the paper vs. mark at lowest position

label: Needle to lower looper clearance
valueText: The clearance between the needles and lower looper should be 0 - 0.05 mm
conditions: tip of lower looper behind the needles
reference: lower looper tip to left and right needles

label: Lower looper position (tip to left needle, leftmost)
valueText: The distance between the tip of the lower looper and the left side of the left needle should be 2.6 - 3.1 mm when the lower looper is at the left most position.
conditions: lower looper at leftmost position
reference: lower looper tip to left side of left needle

label: Lower looper height
valueText: Height of the lower looper: 65 mm (See page 13.)
conditions: lower looper tip set at the corner of the gauge (Fig. 2)
reference: lower looper tip height, set with gauge

label: Needle guard to needles clearance
valueText: The clearancce between the needles and needle guard should be 0 - 0.1 mm.
conditions: #14/90 needles; needles at lowest position
reference: needle guard to needles

label: Upper looper position (tip to left needle, leftmost)
valueText: The distance between the tip of the tip of the upper looper and the left side of the left needle should be 5.2 - 5.6 mm when the upper looper is at the left most position.
conditions: upper looper at leftmost position
reference: upper looper tip to left side of left needle

label: Upper to lower looper clearance
valueText: The clearance between the upper and lower loopers should be 0.05 - 0.2 mm.
conditions: tip of upper looper behind lower looper
reference: upper looper to lower looper

label: Upper/lower looper timing (hump distance)
valueText: The distance between the upper edge of the upper looper and bottom of the hump on the lower looper should be 1.0 - 1.5 mm when the tip of the upper looper meets with the upper edge of the lower looper.
conditions: tip of upper looper meets upper edge of lower looper
reference: upper edge of upper looper to bottom of lower looper hump

label: Lower looper thread guide gap
valueText: check if there is a 0.5 - 2.0 gap between the lower looper thread guide and the CS fixed plate.
conditions: thread guide returned to original position
reference: lower looper thread guide to CS fixed plate

label: Upper looper take-up lever height
valueText: The height of the upper looper take up lever should be 46.0 - 47.3 mm when it is at the highest position.
conditions: take-up lever at highest position
reference: upper edge of lever above base cover

label: Differential feed regulator rod setting
valueText: Differential feed: 12 mm (See page 19.)
conditions: S.L. dial 0.5, D.F. dial 1; feed dogs at highest position
reference: DF regulator rod pressed against gauge
notes: Main and sub feed dogs must move the same distance at D.F. 1.

label: Fixed blade to needle plate edge (cutting width 1)
valueText: The clearance between the fixed blade (lower knife) and edge of the needle plate should be 0.2 - 0.3 mm when the cutting width dial is set at "1".
conditions: cutting width dial at 1; moving blade disengaged
reference: fixed blade (lower knife) to needle plate edge
notes: Set to 0.3 mm, then check 0.2-0.3 mm.

label: Cutter knob to moving blade shift rod
valueText: The clearance between them should be 0.1 - 0.2 mm.
conditions: moving blade at lowest position; cutting width dial turned from 1 to 7
reference: cutter knob to moving blade shift rod

label: Motor belt deflection
valueText: The motor belt should deflect 3 - 8 mm when 200 gr of pressure is applied to the center of the belt.
conditions: 200 g applied to center of belt
reference: belt deflection at mid-span

label: Needle bar height
valueText: The distance between the tip of needle on the right and the surface of needle plate (B) should be between 11.2 and 11.6 mm when the needle bar (C) is at its highest position.
conditions: needle bar at highest position
reference: tip of right needle to needle plate surface

label: Presser bar height (foot raised)
valueText: The distance between the surface of needle plate (C) and bottom of presser foot should be between 4.7 and 5.3 mm (0.185 and 0.209) when the presser bar lifter (D) is raised.
conditions: presser bar lifter raised
reference: needle plate surface to bottom of presser foot
notes: Side of foot parallel with feed dog slot.

label: Feed dog height (foot-to-plate gap)
valueText: When the presser foot is lowered and the feed dogs are at their highest position, the distance between the surface of needle plate (C) and bottom of presser foot (G) should be between 0.75 mm and 0.95 mm.
conditions: stitch length 3, differential 1.0; presser foot lowered; feed dogs at highest position
reference: needle plate surface to bottom of lowered presser foot
notes: Sub feed dog set level with needle plate when main feed dog is at plate level.

label: Needle to feed dog timing
valueText: Turn the handwheel to adjust the tip of right needle height to 2 mm (J) above the surface of needle plate. The top of the feed dog teeth (K) should be leveled with the top sufrace of needle plate (L) at the end of feed movement.
conditions: feed regulator 3.0, differential 1.0; right needle 2 mm above plate in downward motion; presser foot lowered
reference: feed dog teeth level with needle plate at end of feed movement

label: Main feed cam to bushing clearance
valueText: Clearance between main feed cam and bushing should be 1 mm (X).
conditions: sub feed cam pinned to main feed cam with guide pin through 2.5 mm hole
reference: main feed cam to bushing

label: Stitch length calibration (dial 3)
valueText: The actual stitch length (F) should be 2.8 to 3.0 mm when the stitch dial is set at "3".
conditions: stitch length dial 3; differential 1.0
reference: actual sewn stitch length

label: Needle to lower looper clearance
valueText: the clearance between either needle and lower looper (G) should be between 0 and 0.1 mm
conditions: tip of lower looper comes from the left just behind the needle
reference: needle to tip of lower looper
notes: Step 3 sets the right needle to lower looper at 0.1-0.2 mm with the driving arm before the front needle guard is pushed in; final standard is 0-0.1 mm.

label: Rear needle guard clearance
valueText: the clearance between both needles and rear needle guard (H) should be between 0 and 0.2 mm.
conditions: lower looper tip just behind the needle
reference: needles to rear needle guard
notes: Step 6 sets the rear guard to 0.1-0.3 mm before final check.

label: Fixed needle guard clearance
valueText: The clearance between needle (B) and the fixed guard (C) should be 0.1 to 0.4 mm (D).
conditions: needle at lowest position; needle plate setting knob at "S"
reference: needle to fixed needle guard

label: Lower looper timing (needle rise)
valueText: When the needle comes up 1.6 mm (A) from its lowest position, the tip of lower looper (B) matches with the left side of left needle (C).
conditions: needle raised 1.6 mm from lowest position
reference: lower looper tip at left side of left needle

label: Upper looper position (needle to looper eye)
valueText: When the upper looper (A) is at the leftmost position, the distance between the center of needle on the right and the center of looper eye should be 4.8 to 5.2 mm (B).
conditions: upper looper at leftmost position
reference: center of right needle to center of upper looper eye

label: Upper looper height (shaft guide to looper)
valueText: The distance should be 1.6 to 1.8 mm (E) when the upper looper (A) is at the lowest position
conditions: upper looper at lowest position
reference: upper looper shaft guide to bottom of upper looper

label: Upper/lower looper timing
valueText: the lower looper (C) meets the upper looper (D) within 1 mm (J) from the left of lower looper eye at a right angle
conditions: lower looper moving to the right
reference: meeting point from left edge of lower looper eye

label: Upper to lower looper clearance
valueText: When the loopers meet as shown in (Fig. 2), the clearance should be between 0 and 0.2 mm (D)
conditions: loopers crossing
reference: upper looper to lower looper

label: Upper looper to left needle clearance
valueText: When the upper looper (A) meets with needle, clearance (C) should be: 0.1 to 0.15 mm at the needle on the left.
conditions: needle lowered just behind upper looper
reference: upper looper to left needle

label: Upper looper to right needle clearance
valueText: 0.2 to 0.05 mm at the needle on the right.
conditions: needle lowered just behind upper looper
reference: upper looper to right needle
notes: Printed "0.2 to 0.05 mm" (checked on page image) - range order looks like a misprint; the 744D/7034D manuals give -0.05 to +0.05 mm for the right needle. Values left blank.

label: Upper knife depth below lower knife
valueText: When the upper knife (C) is at the lowest position, the front lower corner of upper knife should be 0.8 to 1.5 mm (D) below the edge of lower knife.
conditions: upper knife at lowest position; lower knife edge level with needle plate
reference: front lower corner of upper knife below lower knife edge
notes: Upper knife timing: at highest position when needle bar is at highest position.

label: Cloth presser bar height
valueText: Gauge Nb 11951 4.7mm Height of cloth presser bar
conditions: shank holder at highest position; feed dog below needle plate; foot pushed down onto gauge
reference: presser foot to needle plate (gauge)
notes: Gauge dimension only; no tolerance printed. Align foot openings with needle plate.

label: Needle bar height
valueText: 12 +-0.2 mm (Fig. 2); Gauge 12.0mm Height of needle bar
conditions: new No. 90 needle in R1; needle bar at highest position; needle grazes gauge
reference: tip of R1 needle to needle plate
notes: Tolerance read from figure label "12 +-0.2 mm".

label: Needle to lower looper clearance
valueText: obtain a clearance of less than 0.05mm between point of looper and needle
conditions: lower looper point behind overlock needle
reference: lower looper point to needle

label: Lower looper angular position (tip to overlock needle)
valueText: adjust lever "c" angularly to obtain 2.6 to 3.1mm between point of looper and the left side of the overlock needle
conditions: lower looper at far left swing position
reference: lower looper point to left side of overlock needle R1

label: Lower looper height
valueText: Gauge 65.0mm Height of lower looper
conditions: set with gauge
reference: lower looper height (gauge)

label: Overlock needle guard clearance
valueText: Shift needle guard "c" back and forth to obtain a clearance of 0.05mm between needle guard "c" and needles (fig. 0~0.05mm)
conditions: No. 90 needles in R1 and R2; needle bar at lowest position
reference: needle guard to needles

label: Overlock needle guard height
valueText: 2.7~3.4mm (figure)
conditions: needle bar at lowest position
reference: needle guard top edge relative to needle (per figure)
notes: Figure label only; the text does not say what the 2.7-3.4 mm is measured from (appears to be guard top vs. needle eye area).

label: Upper looper angular position (tip to overlock needle)
valueText: adjust lever "e" angularly to obtain a 5.6mm gap between point of looper and the left side of the overlock needle (fig. 5.2~5.6 mm)
conditions: upper looper at far left swing position
reference: upper looper point to left side of overlock needle R1

label: Upper to lower looper clearance
valueText: 0.05~0.2mm (figure)
conditions: upper looper passing lower looper
reference: upper looper to lower looper
notes: Figure labels only on this page (text of page 10 not in text layer); same values as 1100D manual.

label: Upper/lower looper timing (hump distance)
valueText: 1.0~1.5mm (figure)
conditions: upper looper tip meets lower looper
reference: upper looper to lower looper hump

label: Chain looper angular position
valueText: adjust the chain looper arm "d" angularly to obtain a clearBOce of 1.5 to 1.8mm
conditions: chain looper at far right swing position; No. 90 needle in L2
reference: point of chain looper to chain needle

label: Chain looper to cover hem needle clearance
valueText: check if clearance is less than 0.05mm (L2 and L0)
conditions: chain looper point moving right to left behind L2, then L0
reference: chain looper point to cover hem needles

label: Chain needle guard clearance
valueText: the clearance between coverhem needle(s) and chain needle guard should be less than 0.1 mm
conditions: cover hem needles at closest approach to guard
reference: cover hem needles to chain needle guard

label: Chain needle guard to chain looper tip gap
valueText: make sure that the gap between chain needle guard and the tip of chain looper is set at 1.0 ~ 2.0 mm
reference: chain needle guard to tip of chain looper

label: Chain looper orbital timing eccentric marks
valueText: The distance between marks "c" and "d" should be within -1.0 to 1.0 mm.
conditions: needle bar at upper edge of R1 eye flush with needle plate (downward stroke)
reference: eccentric "6" mark c to mark d

label: Chain looper engagement plate gap
valueText: slide the plate "b" right or left to get the gap 0.5 ~ 2.0mm
conditions: needle bar at lowest position
reference: chain looper engagement lever to plate "b"

label: Feed dog height (gauge)
valueText: Adjust feed dogs height with eccentric "b" to touch gauge (fig. 1.3mm)
conditions: stitch length 0.5, differential 1; feed dogs at highest position; presser bar lowered on gauge
reference: feed dog height set against gauge under presser foot
notes: Page is image-only in text layer; read from page image. Both feed dogs level.

label: Front to back feed dog gap
valueText: Check gap between front and back feed dog (2.7 to 3.2mm).
conditions: feed dogs at highest position
reference: gap between front and back feed dogs

label: Upper knife / vertical feed timing eccentric marks
valueText: The distance between marks "A" and "B" should be within -0.5 to 0.5mm.
conditions: needle bar raised until lower edge of R1 eye is flush with needle plate
reference: eccentric "7" mark A to mark B
notes: Upper knife and needle bar start down together from highest position. Read from page image.

label: Upper knife height below fixed cutter
valueText: the tip of upper knife blade is at 0.5 to 0.8 mm below the fixed cutter
conditions: moving cutter at lowest position
reference: upper knife tip below fixed cutter

label: Horizontal feed timing (chainstitch needle)
conditions: stitch length 4, differential 1; paper under foot; L0 needle
reference: needle point in middle or front edge of the hole made in the paper
notes: Tolerance read from figure 3 on page image.

label: Differential feed crank setting
valueText: 12~12.3mm (figure)
conditions: stitch length 0.5; DF at 1
reference: differential feed crank "b" dimension
notes: Figure label on page image; both feed dogs must move equal lengths at DF 1.

label: Fixed blade to needle plate edge
valueText: check if clearance of 0.2 to 0.3mm is obtained between fixed blade "b" and needle plate edge
conditions: cutting width dial at 1; upper knife disengaged
reference: fixed blade to needle plate edge

label: Cutter release knob to shaft support gap
valueText: the gap between "g" and "h" is 0.1 ~ 0.2mm
conditions: moving cutter at lowest position; dial at 1
reference: moving cutter release knob to shaft support
notes: Knob should touch the shaft support at dial 7. Figure shows 0.1-0.3 mm at dial 1.

label: Upper looper thread take-up lever position
valueText: the distance between thread take up lever guide and inside of the machine base is at 46.0 to 47.3 mm
conditions: upper looper take-up lever at highest position
reference: take-up lever guide to inside of machine base

label: Presser foot safety switch lever gap
valueText: adjust the position of safety lever "d" to get the gap 0~0.2mm
conditions: presser foot lever lowered, micro switch off position
reference: safety lever gap (Fig. 3)

label: Top cover hook to L0 needle gap
valueText: the gap between the top cover hook and Coverhem needle "L0" is 1.0 mm (fig. 1.0 mm +0.5/-0.5)
conditions: program 10 coverhem/chainstitch; top cover hook in front of needles
reference: top cover hook to L0 needle

label: Top cover hook to round thread guide height
valueText: slide the round thread guide "h" ... until you get 2.5 ~ 3.0mm height between the top cover hook and the round thread guide "h"
conditions: top cover hook at far right
reference: top cover hook to round thread guide
notes: Read from page image. Same page also sets lever "a" 0 +-0.5 mm and lever "i" 0-1.0 mm.

label: Feed dog to needle plate slot, rear
valueText: obtain a clearance "F" of 0.3 to 0.5mm
conditions: SL dial 5, DF dial 1; feed dog at far rear position
reference: feed dog to needle plate (rear)

label: Feed dog to needle plate slot, front
valueText: Check and make sure if a clearance between feed dog and needle plate is 0.7mm.
conditions: SL dial 5, DF dial 1; feed dog at far front position
reference: feed dog to needle plate (front)

label: Presser bar height (foot raised)
valueText: THE DISTANCE BETWEEN THE PRESSER FOOT (D) AND THE NEEDLE PLATE (E) SHOULD BE 6.0 MM (0.24).
conditions: presser foot lifter raised
reference: presser foot to needle plate
notes: Foot parallel to feed dog slots.

label: Needle swing start height
valueText: UNTIL THE NEEDLE SWING STARTS 2-3 MM ABOVE THE NEEDLE PLATE AFTER THE NEEDLE HAS COME OUT OF THE RIGHT SIDE OF THE NEEDLE HOLE.
conditions: maximum zigzag width; needle rising out of right side of hole
reference: needle point above needle plate when swing starts

label: Needle to shuttle race clearance
valueText: THE CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE NEEDLE AND SHUTTLE RACE SHOULD BE -0.05 TO +0.10 MM.
reference: needle to shuttle race / shuttle hook
notes: Method 1: needle bar supporter; method 2: move shuttle race.

label: Needle to needle plate hole clearance
valueText: CLEARANCE BETWEEN NEEDLE AND NEEDLE PLATE SHOULD BE 0.15 MM OR MORE.
conditions: after needle-to-shuttle clearance adjustment
reference: needle to needle plate hole edge (figure D)

label: Shuttle driver rotary play
valueText: THE ROTARY PLAY OF THE TIP OF THE SHUTTLE DRIVER SHOULD BE 0.3 MM OR LESS
reference: play at tip of shuttle driver

label: Feed dog height
valueText: THE FEED DOG ABOVE THE NEEDLE PLATE SHOULD BE 0.75-0.90 MM.
conditions: presser foot lowered; feed dog at highest point
reference: feed dog above needle plate

label: Needle bar height (eye to shuttle hook tip)
valueText: THE DISTANCE BETWEEN THE TOP OF THE NEEDLE EYE AND THE TIP OF THE SHUTTLE HOOK SHOULD BE IN THE RANGE OF 2.9-3.5 MM.
conditions: shuttle hook tip meets left side of needle, ascending from left lowest position
reference: top of needle eye to tip of shuttle hook

label: Needle rise for shuttle hook timing
valueText: THE HEIGHT OF THE NEEDLE POINT FROM ITS LOWEST POINT OF TRAVEL SHOULD BE IN THE RANGE OF 1.45-1.95 MM WHEN THE TIP OF THE SHUTTLE HOOK JUST MEETS THE LEFT SIDE OF THE NEEDLE AT THE LEFT NEEDLE POSITION.
conditions: left needle position; hook tip meets left side of needle
reference: needle rise from lowest position

label: Motor belt deflection
valueText: THE BELT DEFLECTION SHOULD BE 7 MM - 9 MM WHEN PRESSING THE MIDDLE OF THE MOTOR BELT WITH APPROXIMATELY 300 GRAMS OF PRESSURE.
conditions: approx. 300 g at middle of belt
reference: belt deflection

label: Needle bar height (upper hairline)
valueText: Move the needle bar up or down and match the upper hairline with the bottom edge of the needle bar bushing.
conditions: needle bar at lowest position
reference: upper hairline on needle bar to bottom edge of needle bar bushing
notes: No numeric value; set by hairline. Needle clamp screw parallel to upper shaft.

label: Presser bar height (foot raised)
valueText: The distance between the bottom of the presser foot in up position and the needle plate should be 5.7-6.3 mm.
conditions: presser foot up; feed dog lowered
reference: bottom of presser foot to needle plate

label: Feed dog height
valueText: When the feed dog is fully raised the height should be 0.8-1.0 mm above the needle plate.
conditions: stitch length dial at 6 (max); feed dog at highest position
reference: feed dog above needle plate
notes: Adjust to 0.9 mm with eccentric pin.

label: Center feed dog to slot front clearance
valueText: The crealance between the front end of the center feed dog and center slot should be 4.2-4.8 mm when the stitch length dial is set at 0.
conditions: stitch length dial at 0
reference: front end of center feed dog to center slot
notes: Set to 4.5 mm; lateral gaps even.

label: Feed cam timing
valueText: Lower the needle bar ... until the point of the needle is 17.5 mm above the upper surface of the needle plate. The feed dogs should not move when moving the reverse stitch lever up and down.
conditions: needle point 17.5 mm above needle plate (descending)
reference: feed dogs do not move when reverse lever is operated

label: Feed lifting cam timing
valueText: Lower the needle bar until the point of needle is 0.4 mm below the needle plate. The top of the feed dogs should be 0-0.1 mm above the needle plate.
conditions: needle point 0.4 mm below needle plate
reference: top of feed dogs above needle plate

label: Needle bar rise for hook timing (lower hairline)
valueText: Raise the needle bar from the lowest position until the lower heirline of the needle bar matches the edge of the needle bar bushing. NOTE: The needle bar rises 2 mm from the lowest position.
conditions: hook point matched to right side of needle
reference: needle bar rise from lowest position (lower hairline at bushing edge)

label: Needle to hook point clearance
valueText: The clearance between the needle and hook point should be 0-0.1 mm.
conditions: hook point behind needle
reference: needle to hook point

label: Hook thread path gap
valueText: check the needle to hook timing and the thread path e (0.4-0.8 mm).
conditions: after hook clearance adjustment
reference: thread path (e) at the hook, per figure
notes: Figure marks the gap as "thread path"; exact parts not named in text.

label: Bobbin winder stopper (wound diameter)
valueText: The amount of thread wound on the bobbin should be 16.5-19.5 mm in diameter.

label: Check spring stroke (thread drawn)
valueText: The amount of the needle thread supplied by the check spring should be 11-15 mm.
conditions: threaded to thread guide; presser foot lowered; needle bar at lowest position
reference: length of thread drawn out by full check-spring stroke

label: Knee lifter lift
valueText: The presser foot rises 7.5 mm when it is fully raised with the knee lifter.
conditions: knee lifter fully raised
reference: presser foot lift
notes: Needle clamp must not hit the raised foot at lowest needle position.

label: Motor belt deflection
valueText: The belt should deflect 4-5 mm when applying 300 grams of load to the middle of the belt.
conditions: 300 g at middle of belt
reference: belt deflection

label: Needle stop position sensor
valueText: Lower the needle bar ... until the needle point is 18.7 mm above the upper surface of the needle plate r. ... Rotate the upper shaft shielding plate toward you until the green LED turns on.
conditions: service mode; needle point 18.7 mm above needle plate
reference: needle point above needle plate when sensor LED turns on

label: Thread cutter blade point position
valueText: The point y of the thread cutter blade should be 2-2.5 mm from the center of the needle drop position u.

valueText: The clearance between the wire and the tip of the hook barb should be 0.5 mm or more.
reference: threader wire to tip of hook barb

label: Needle threader wire to hook barb clearance
valueText: The clearance between the wire and the tip of the hook barb should be 0.5 mm or more.
reference: threader wire to tip of hook barb

label: Needle threader wire to hook barb clearance
valueText: The clearance between the wire and the tip of the hook barb should be 0.5 mm or more.
reference: threader wire to tip of hook barb

label: Presser bar height (foot raised)
valueText: The distance between the bottom of the presser foot in up position and the needle plate should be 4.7-5.3 mm.
conditions: presser foot up
reference: bottom of presser foot to needle plate

label: Foot pressure adjusting screw height
valueText: The pressure adjusting screw should protrude 10 mm from the top of the machine.
reference: pressure adjusting screw protrusion above top of machine

label: Needle bar height
valueText: The distance between the point of the left needle (Schmetz ELx705, size 80/12) and the upper surface of the needle plate should be 8.4-8.8 mm when the needle bar is at the highest position.
conditions: needle bar at highest position; Schmetz ELx705 80/12 in left position
reference: left needle point to needle plate surface

label: Feed dog height
valueText: When the presser foot is lowered, the maximum height of the feed dog should be 0.75-0.95 mm above the needle plate.
conditions: presser foot lowered; feed dog at highest position
reference: feed dog above needle plate

label: Looper height
valueText: The hight of the looper point should be 72.6-73.0 mm.
conditions: short test pin (28.8 mm) in right needle position; looper point matched to tip of test pin
reference: looper point height (set by test pin tip)

label: Looper position (point to right needle, rightmost)
valueText: The distance between the looper point and center of the right needle should be 1.8-2.2 mm when the looper is at the right most position.
conditions: looper at rightmost position; short test pin
reference: looper point to center of right needle

label: Needle to looper timing (needle bar rise)
valueText: When the point of the looper meets with the right side of the needle on the right, the needle bar rises 1.3-1.5 mm from the lowest position.
conditions: looper point meets right side of right needle
reference: needle bar rise from lowest position

label: Needle to looper clearance
valueText: The clearance between the looper point and scarf of the needle (Schmetz ELx705, size 80/12) should be 0-0.05 mm.
conditions: looper point behind the needle; set by pushing front needle guard against needle
reference: looper point to needle scarf

label: Back needle guard height
valueText: The upper edge of the back needle guard should be 2.7-2.9 mm below the lower edge of the looper point when the looper point meets with the right side of the needle.
conditions: looper point meets right side of needle
reference: upper edge of back needle guard below lower edge of looper point

label: Back needle guard clearance
valueText: Check the clearance between the back needle guard and the needle (Schmetz ELx705, size 80/12). It should be 0.1-0.3 mm.
conditions: looper point behind the needle
reference: back needle guard to needle

label: Needle to feed dog timing
valueText: The point of the left needle should be 2-4 mm above the upper surface of the needle plate when the top of the feed dogs are level with the upper surface of the needle plate in downward motion.
conditions: stitch length 3, differential 1.0
reference: left needle point above needle plate when feed dogs are level with plate (downward)
notes: Set with needle 3.0 mm above plate.

label: Stitch length calibration (dial 3)
valueText: The stitch length should be 3.0-3.2 mm when the stitch length dial is set at 3 and differential feed dial at 1.0.
conditions: stitch length 3, differential 1.0
reference: needle marks of 10 stitches = 30-32 mm

label: Motor belt deflection
valueText: The motor belt should deflect 7-9 mm when applying 300 grams of load to the middle of the belt.
conditions: 300 g at middle of belt
reference: belt deflection

label: Needle to needle hole side clearance
valueText: WHEN THE NEEDLE SWINGS IN MAXIMUM ZIGZAG WIDTH, THE DISTANCE BETWEEN BOTH ENDS OF THE NEEDLE HOLE IN THE NEEDLE PLATE AND THE NEEDLE SHOULD BE 0.2 MM OR MORE.
conditions: maximum zigzag width
reference: needle to both ends of needle hole

label: Needle bar height (eye to hook tip)
valueText: THE DISTANCE BETWEEN THE UPPER EDGE OF NEEDLE EYE AND THE TIP OF THE HOOK SHOULD BE IN THE RANGE OF 1.6-2.0 MM
conditions: hook tip meets right side of needle ascending from left lowest position
reference: upper edge of needle eye to hook tip

label: Needle bar rise for hook timing
valueText: AMOUNT OF ASCENDING TRAVEL OF THE NEEDLE BAR FROM ITS LOWEST POSITION TO THE POSITION WHERE THE TIP OF THE HOOK MEETS THE RIGHT SIDE OF THE NEEDLE SHOULD BE 3.25 - 3.55 MM.
conditions: left needle position
reference: needle bar rise from lowest position

label: Test pin to hook tip clearance
valueText: THE CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE TEST PIN AND THE TIP OF THE HOOK SHOULD BE BETWEEN -0.10 AND +0.05 MM.
conditions: test pin
reference: test pin to hook tip

label: Hook rotary play
valueText: THE STANDARD PLAY SHOULD BE 0.8 MM (0.03) OR LESS WHEN THE HOOK POINT IS WITHIN THE FEED DOG WIDTH.
conditions: hook point within feed dog width
reference: rotary play at hook point

label: Feed dog height
valueText: THE HIGHEST POSITION OF THE FEED DOG SHOULD BE BETWEEN 0.8 TO 0.9 MM FROM THE SURFACE OF THE NEEDLE PLATE WHEN THE THE PRESSER FOOT IS RAISED.
conditions: feed dog at highest position
reference: feed dog above needle plate surface
notes: Statement says presser foot raised (sister 7330 manual says pressure dial 3 and lowers the foot in the procedure).

label: Zigzag synchronization (swing start)
valueText: THE NEEDLE SHOULD START SWING BETWEEN 6.3 TO 7.5 MM ABOVE THE SURFACE OF THE NEEDLE PLATE WHEN THE MACHINE IS SET FOR ZIGZAG STITCHING.
conditions: zigzag stitch
reference: needle above needle plate when swing starts

label: Tension release travel (tension disk supporter)
valueText: WHEN THE PRESSER FOOT LIFTER IS RAISED, THE TENSION DISK SUPPORTER SHOULD MOVE APPROXIMATELY 1 MM.
conditions: presser foot lifter raised
reference: tension disk supporter movement

label: Presser bar height (foot raised)
valueText: WHEN THE PRESSER FOOT IS RAISED, THE CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE PRESSER FOOT AND THE NEEDLE PLATE SHOULD BE 5.7 TO 6.3 MM.
conditions: presser foot raised
reference: presser foot to needle plate

label: Motor belt deflection
valueText: 300 GRAMS PRESSURE IN THE MIDDLE OF THE BELT, IT SHOULD DEFLECT 7 TO 9 MM
conditions: 300 g at middle of belt
reference: belt deflection

label: Presser bar height (zigzag foot raised)
valueText: The distance between the zigzag foot (A) and the needle plate (C) should be 6.0 mm.
conditions: presser foot raised
reference: zigzag foot to needle plate

label: Needle swing start height
valueText: lateral needle swing starts from a position 2 to 3mm above the needle plate in right outflow (E).
conditions: zigzag; needle rising on right side
reference: needle above needle plate when swing starts

label: Master needle to hook tip clearance
valueText: The clearance between the master needle (D) and the tip of the rotary hook (E) should be between -0.10 and +0.05 mm.
conditions: stitch No. 12 (simple zigzag); needle bar at lowest position
reference: master needle to tip of rotary hook

label: Hook rotary play (gear backlash)
valueText: Rotate the hook race clockwise and counterclockwise by hand and check the play (J). It should be within 0.8 mm.
conditions: hook tip within width of feed dog
reference: rotary play at hook tip

label: Needle bar height (eye to hook race)
valueText: the distance between the upper edge of the needle eye and the race (F) of rotary hook should be 1.7 to 2.1mm.
conditions: pattern No. 12, zigzag width 6.5, left needle drop; hook tip meets right of needle ascending
reference: upper edge of needle eye to race of rotary hook

label: Needle bar rise for hook timing
valueText: the amount of ascending travel of the needle bar from its lower position (H) to the position where the tip of the rotary hook (F) exactly meets the right side of the needle should be 3.15 to 3.45mm (G).
conditions: pattern No. 12, zigzag width 6.5, needle swung left
reference: needle bar rise from lowest position

label: Feed dog height
valueText: When the presser foot (D) is lowered with the pressure dial set (I) at " 3, "the highest position of the feed dog (E) should be 0.75 to 0.85mm above the top surface (F) of the needle plate.
conditions: pressure dial 3; presser foot lowered; feed dog at highest position
reference: feed dog above needle plate top surface

label: Motor belt deflection
valueText: The correct motor belt tension is achieved when the belt pushes in about 7mm - 9mm under a pressure of about 300 grams.
conditions: about 300 g
reference: belt deflection

label: Needle bar height (upper hairline; eye to hook race check)
valueText: match the upper hairline with the bottom edge of the needle bar bushing. * The distance between the upper edge of the needle eye and the hook race will be in the range of 1.5 to 2.1 mm when the tip of the hook meets right side of the needle as the needle ascends 2.0mm from its lowest position
conditions: needle bar at lowest position for hairline setting; check at 2.0 mm rise
reference: upper edge of needle eye to hook race (check); upper hairline to bushing bottom edge (set)

label: Presser bar height (foot raised)
valueText: The distance between the bottom of the presser foot in up position and the needle plate should be 5.7 to 6.3 mm.
conditions: presser foot up; feed dog lowered
reference: bottom of presser foot to needle plate

label: Feed dog height
valueText: When the feed dog is fully raised the height should be 0.8 to 1.0 mm above the needle plate.
conditions: stitch length dial 6 (max); feed dog at highest position
reference: feed dog above needle plate

label: Center feed dog to slot front clearance
valueText: The clearance between the front end of the center feed dog and center slot should be 4.2 to 4.8 mm when the stitch length dial is set at 0.
conditions: stitch length dial 0
reference: front end of center feed dog to center slot
notes: Set to 4.5 mm; lateral gaps even.

label: Feed cam timing
valueText: Lower the needle bar ... until the point of the needle is 17.5 mm above the upper surface of the needle plate. The feed dogs should not move when moving the reverse stitch lever up and down.
conditions: needle point 17.5 mm above needle plate
reference: feed dogs do not move when reverse lever is operated

label: Feed lifting cam timing
valueText: Lower the needle bar until the point of needle is 0.4 mm below the needle plate. The top of the feed dogs should be 0 to 0.1 mm above the needle plate.
conditions: needle point 0.4 mm below needle plate
reference: top of feed dogs above needle plate

label: Needle bar rise for hook timing (lower hairline)
valueText: Raise the needle bar from the lowest position until the lower hairline of the needle bar matches the edge of the needle bar bushing. NOTE: The needle bar rises 2 mm from the lowest position. (fig. 1.8 to 2.2 mm)
conditions: hook point matched to right side of needle
reference: needle bar rise from lowest position

label: Needle to hook point clearance
valueText: The clearance between the needle and hook point should be 0 to 0.1 mm.
conditions: hook point behind needle
reference: needle to hook point

label: Hook thread path gap
valueText: check the needle to hook timing and the thread path e (0.4 to 0.8 mm).
conditions: after hook clearance adjustment
reference: thread path (e) at the hook, per figure
notes: Figure marks the gap as "thread path"; exact parts not named in text.

label: Bobbin winder stopper (wound diameter)
valueText: The amount of thread wound on the bobbin should be 20 to 22 mm in diameter.
reference: diameter of thread on wound bobbin

label: Check spring stroke (thread drawn)
valueText: The amount of the needle thread supplied by the check spring should be 11 to 15 mm.
conditions: threaded; presser foot lowered; needle bar at lowest position
reference: length of thread drawn out by full check-spring stroke

label: Knee lifter lift
valueText: The presser foot rises 7 to 8 mm when it is fully raised with the knee lifter.
conditions: knee lifter fully raised
reference: presser foot lift

label: Motor belt deflection
valueText: The belt should deflect 7 to 9 mm when applying 300 grams of load to the middle of the belt.
conditions: 300 g at middle of belt
reference: belt deflection

label: Needle stop position sensor
valueText: the needle point is 18.7 mm above the upper surface of the needle plate (sensor LED set)
conditions: service mode; needle point 18.7 mm above needle plate
reference: needle point above needle plate when sensor LED turns on

label: Thread cutter blade point position
valueText: The point of the thread cutter blade should be 2 to 2.5 mm from the center of the needle drop position.
conditions: needle bar at lowest; cutter blade at end of stroke
reference: blade point to center of needle drop
notes: Approx. 5 mm between tail of hook wing and end point of blade.

label: Thread guide plate position
valueText: The left inner edge of the thread guide plate should be approximately 1.4 mm from the center of the needle drop position and the back inner edge ... approximately 2.7 mm

notes: Two separate approximate values: left edge ~1.4 mm, back edge ~2.7 mm.

label: Static cutter blade position
valueText: the distance between the center of the needle drop position and the static cutter blade is 4 mm and the left edges of the static blade and thread cutter blade are aligned.

label: Needle to cutter cam timing
valueText: The needle point should be 10.5 mm above the upper surface of the needle plate when the thread drawing arm starts to move.

notes: Thread drawing lever also set at 10.5 mm needle height (page 30).

label: Intermittent presser foot lift stroke (standard)

label: Presser plate height (underside of presser plate to needle plate top)

reference: underside of presser plate to needle plate top

label: Sensor to presser plate control cam detecting part distance
valueText: Adjust the position of the sensor so that the distance between the sensor and detecting part of the presser plate control cam is approx. 1.5 mm

label: Needle bar height (needle tip above center of rotary/lower shaft)

label: Needle bar thread guide set-screw rotational position
valueText: Adjust the position of the needle bar thread guide so that the set screw on it is turned 25-30 degrees to the right when viewed from the front

label: Presser shaft position (end of bush to presser shaft)

label: Needle to rotary hook clearance
valueText: adjust the rotary hook position so that there is a 0.2-0.4 mm clearance between the needle and the rotary hook point

label: Clearance between rotary hook and inner rotary hook stopper

valueText: The gap between the inside of the rotary hook base and the lower shaft gear should be approximately 0.2 mm.

valueText: The gap between the rotary hook and the needle plate should be 0.6-0.9 mm.

label: Needle bar lift for hook timing
valueText: The rotary hook point should be aligned with the needle center when the needle is 2.4 mm above its down position.
reference: needle rise from its down (lowest) position; hook point at needle center

label: Hook point to top of needle eye (needle bar height)
valueText: The gap between the needle hole top and the rotary hook point should be 1-1.5 mm when the rotary hook point is aligned with the needle center.
conditions: hook point aligned with needle center (needle 2.4 mm up)
reference: top of needle eye to rotary hook point
notes: set by raising/lowering the needle bar

label: Rotary hook to bobbin case opener gap
valueText: The gap between the rotary hook and the bobbin case opener should be 0.2 mm when the bobbin case opener is shifted all the way in the direction of the arrow.
conditions: opener shifted fully in arrow direction
reference: rotary hook to bobbin case opener

label: Binder position: needle to binder indent
valueText: When the binder is down, the needle should descend to approximately the center of the needle location in the binder. The gap between the needle and the binder indent should be 5 mm.
conditions: binder down
reference: needle to binder indent (front-back)

label: Binder to cloth slide plate gap
valueText: When the binder is lowered, the gap between the bottom of the binder and the top of the cloth slide plate should be approximately 1 mm (standard) and these surfaces should be parallel.
conditions: binder lowered
reference: bottom of binder to top of cloth slide plate

label: Cloth guide height above binder
valueText: The gap between the bottom of the cloth guide and the top of the binder assembly should be 0.5-1.5 mm (standard).
conditions: adjust according to material thickness
reference: bottom of cloth guide to top of binder assembly

label: Cloth guide arm lift by hand
valueText: The arm should rise more than 5 mm when lifted by hand, and should be descend smoothly by the presser of the plate spring.
reference: cloth guide arm lift
notes: no play left/right on cloth guide arm

label: Center knife guide height, guide down (power off)
valueText: When the center knife guide is down (the power OFF), the center knife guide should be 3 mm above the top of the needle plate.
conditions: power OFF, guide down
reference: center knife guide to top of needle plate

label: Center knife guide height, guide up (power and air on)
valueText: When the center knife guide is up (the power and the air supply ON), the center knife guide should be 8 mm above the top of the needle plate.
conditions: power and air ON, guide up
reference: center knife guide to top of needle plate

label: Presser bar guide to bush gap (center knife guide)
valueText: When the center knife guide is down (the power OFF), raise or lower the presser bar guide so that the gap between the presser bar guide and the bush is 5 mm.
conditions: power OFF, guide down
reference: presser bar guide to bush

label: Center knife to center knife guide gap
valueText: The gap between the center knife and the center knife guide should be 0.5 mm.
reference: center knife to center knife guide

label: Knee lifter set collar: presser bar lifter to lifting lever gap
valueText: When the knee lifter connecting rod is down (the gap between the center knife and the needle plate is 3 mm), raise or lower the set collar so that the gap between the presser bar lifter and the knee lifter lifting lever is approximately 0.5 mm.
conditions: knee lifter connecting rod down
reference: presser bar lifter to knee lifter lifting lever

label: Center knife tip height above needle plate (guide up)
valueText: When the center knife guide is up (the power and the air supply ON), the gap between the center knife tip and the needle plate top should be 8 mm (the same height as the center knife guide).
conditions: center knife guide up, power and air ON
reference: center knife tip to needle plate top

label: Center knife stroke
valueText: The center knife stroke should be approximately 6.6 mm.
conditions: power and air OFF, link ball raised by hand
reference: center knife up-down stroke

label: Center knife height at up position
valueText: When the center knife is at its up position, the gap between the needle plate top and the corner of the center knife should be 4 mm.
conditions: center knife at up position
reference: needle plate top to corner of center knife
